tech.titleA: Di protocol wey dey make machine wey dey far
tech.titleB: be like say e dey near you.
tech.lead: Video capture, audio, control input, sensor telemetry — all of dem sync for one timeline, all of dem pass one encrypted connection.
tech.thrTitle: E fast pass how human hand and eye dey react
tech.thrLead: Your hand-eye loop dey run for 30–50 ms. Kyber dey run end-to-end for single digit, if condition good.
tech.pushLead: Most real-time system dey put buffer between every step to make network smooth. You go get latency wey steady — but e go high. Kyber dey push data forward di moment e ready, e dey adjust quality, e no dey ever add delay.
tech.clockTitle: One clock wey dey control every stream.
tech.clockLead: Kyber dey measure clock drift every time and e dey arrange everything for one timeline. Di same clock wey dem use live na im dem dey use for playback. No wahala to align frame. No desync between wetin di machine see and wetin e do.
tech.connLead: QUIC/HTTP3 transport, wey dey encrypted end-to-end by default. No separate channel with separate clock and separate way to fail. No firewall configuration wey get 25 port.
tech.prioTitle: Two kain data. Two level of priority.
tech.prioLead: Ten frame don lag? Kyber go show you di latest frame and drop di rest. Press key — dat keystroke go always land.
tech.prioMediaList: Video & audio · Telemetry & sensor · Subtitle & metadata
tech.prioCtrl: Control — we no dey ever drop am
tech.prioCtrlList: Mouse, keyboard, gamepad, touch · USB, file, clipboard · Custom protocol
tech.netTitle: Network dey fail. Kyber dey adjust.
tech.netLead: Satellite dey lose lock. Tower dey jam. Drag di slider make network spoil, then see wetin Kyber dey protect.
tech.n1d: Packet wey miss, e dey rebuild am for local.
tech.n2d: Bandwidth reduce, quality reduce, but latency no change.
tech.n3d: Control dey always important pass video quality.
tech.secTitle: Protection from protocol level. Architecture wey no dey trust anybody.
tech.s1t: Encryption from one end reach di oda end
tech.s1d: Na QUIC/HTTP3 we take build am. We no fit see your traffic, even if e pass through our infrastructure.
tech.s2d: Permission wey detailed well-well: who go connect, wetin dem fit reach, wetin dem fit do.
tech.s3d: DRM for sensitive stream dem, and e dey block screenshot where di OS allow am.
tech.a2d: One operator, plenty machine. Or plenty people wey dey watch, one machine.
tech.a3d: From edge go cloud go operator, across different network boundary.
tech.notLead: Dem build WebRTC ten years ago for video call between human beings. 100–200 ms dey okay for gist. But e dey dangerous for machine control. Di big companies spend years and tens of millions take build dia own teleoperation stack. Kyber na dat same power, for everybody else.
tech.connLegacyD: Different channel, different clock, different way to fail — and plenty firewall port sometimes.
tech.kLate: E dey drop am — di latest frame na im win
tech.wLate: E dey buffer am make playback smooth
tech.kCtrl: E dey resend am, e no dey ever drop am
tech.wCtrl: Dem dey share di same media road
tech.cmpNote: Na Kyber describe dis design goals — no be benchmark.
tech.scopeLead: Real measurement from dis tab: di time between animation frame dem and how long e take before dem handle your click and key. Na so to dey obsess over every millisecond dey look.
tech.scopeTry: Click, touch or type anywhere make we measure di input delay.
tech.stSkipped: dem skip am — newer frame dey
tech.fecTitle: Lose one packet. Build am back.
tech.fecLead: Four data packet dey travel with one XOR parity packet. If one drop, di receiver go build am back for im side, no need to go and come back. If two drop, e no go fit recover — na why Kyber still dey adjust quality.
tech.fecDrop: Click di packet dem make dem drop
tech.fecOk: E don recover am for im side — no resend, no waiting
tech.fecFail: Too much loss — e need resend
tech.fecIntact: All di packet dem don reach
tech.fecModel: Na model for teaching — no be Kyber real FEC scheme

about.lead: We dey build di infrastructure wey dey make distance disappear.
about.storyTitle: Machine control still dey stuck for 2010. We dey fix am.
about.story1: One surgeon for Paris dey guide robot arm for village side for Brittany. One warehouse operator for Chicago take over forklift wey don hang. One drone pilot need to take control sharp-sharp when di machine lose im AI lock.
about.story2: For each case, network na di enemy. For 200 milliseconds, na wetin don happen you dey watch. For 8 milliseconds, na wetin dey happen you dey control. Na dat gap dey between to dey watch and to dey control — between safe operation and accident. We don close am.
about.teamTitle: From di team wey build VLC.
about.teamLead: Na Kyber founders build VLC — wey dey for billions of devices — and dem contribute to FFmpeg, di engine wey dey behind most video for internet. Twenty years of video infrastructure, open source and deep protocol sabi, now dem don carry am enter new areas.
about.v1t: We no dey ship until e correct
about.v1d: Twenty years don teach us say shortcut dey cost pass wetin e dey save. Every millisecond matter.
about.v2d: Openness dey bring trust, e dey give sovereignty and e dey build ecosystem.
about.v3d: Surgeons, operators, engineers. Di technology go disappear; human power go expand.
about.v4t: We go show first, then we talk
about.v4d: We go ship first, then we celebrate. We get confidence because we good — no be because we talk am.
about.v5d: We dey hire for both sense and kindness. We don pass talent wey no fit us — and we go do am again.
about.careersLead: Na focused team wey dey face one of di computing problem wey nobody don solve. Our headquarters dey Paris, and we dey grow for San Francisco. We dey move sharp-sharp, we dey argue about protocol, and we dey build tins wey dey work.
about.j5: Engineer wey dey work for client ground
about.officesLead: Our headquarters dey for di heart of Paris, and we get facilities for US and Asia to support clients anywhere wey dem dey operate.

faq.title: Questions wey pipo dey ask well-well
faq.a1: Na dual licence model. Open source AGPL v3 dey free to use, but every solution wey integrate Kyber must also publish under AGPL; e cover streaming wit community support. Di commercial licence add support wey dey only for you, help for integration, special features like KyHub (our administration portal), and shared source wey no get distribution rights.
faq.q2: I fit install Kyber by myself?
faq.a2: Yes. Follow di installation guide dem for our GitLab: gitlab.com/kyber/kyber.
faq.q3: Which kain support una dey give?
faq.a3: Wit di AGPL v3 licence, you go get community support for r/kyber. If you want support wey dey only for you, buy commercial licence and contact our sales team.
faq.a4: Our main office dey Paris, and we get office for San Francisco and Singapore to support our clients.
faq.q5: How una dey support di open source community?
faq.a5: Kyber main product dey under AGPL v3. We build am on top VLC libraries and FFmpeg, and we dey contribute well-well to both. We dey host open source tools by ourselves anywhere wey we fit, and we dey give back.

simple.title: Kyber, for simple words
simple.whatD: Kyber dey make pipo control machines from far — robots, drones, motor or computers — with almost no delay. Wetin you do go reach for like 8 thousandth of one second.
simple.whoD: Di team wey dey behind VLC, di free video player wey hundreds of millions of pipo dey use. Di company dey Paris.
simple.uses: Wetin dem dey use am do?
simple.u1: To work for computer wey dey far like say e dey your front
simple.u2: To guide robots and drones well-well without wahala
simple.u3: Dey help motor wey dey drive imsef when e need human being
simple.u4: Dey show 3D picture to doctors and engineers
simple.back: Go back to di full website
simple.whatD2: E dey work like live video call wit machine: you go see im screen or camera, and your mouse, keyboard or joystick go reach am sharp-sharp.
simple.whyD: When you dey control robot or motor from far place, every small second dey count. Normal video call fit delay reach one-fifth of one second, and dat one fit make you miss corner. Dem build Kyber make e fast pass wetin your eye and hand fit notice.
simple.h1: Install Kyber for di machine wey you wan control.
simple.h2: Open Kyber for your computer, for your browser or for headset.
simple.h3: Connect. Picture, sound and control go waka togeda for one encrypted link: e fast and e private.
simple.freeD: Yes. Di code na open source and e free to use. Companies wey need private use, support or special features fit collect commercial licence.

simple.audioErr: Di audio no gree load. Abeg try again later.

car.lead: To control machine for real time na one of di wahala wey computing never solve. We be 26 people from di VLC and FFmpeg community, and we dey build di open version wey everybody fit use.
car.seeRoles: See di work wey dey open
car.spont: Apply even if no role match you
car.st4: VLC downloads wey we don do
car.missionD: For 200 milliseconds, you dey watch wetin don happen. For 8 milliseconds, you dey control wetin dey happen. Na dat gap we dey close — for surgeons, operators, drone pilots and AI agents — and we dey publish di code make anybody fit build on top am.
car.legacyD: Our founding team build VLC, di player wey dey inside billions of devices, and dem contribute to FFmpeg, di engine wey dey behind most video for internet. Kyber carry twenty years of lesson wey we learn di hard way about clocks, codecs and networks — and point am to machines.
car.teamD: You go work direct with di people wey write di code wey you dey use every day — no middle man.
car.envT: Engineering first. Every oda tin follow.
car.e1d: Plus small Go. Every cycle, every copy and every queue matter to us.
car.e2d: Most of wetin you build go ship under AGPL for GitLab, with your name for di history.
car.e3d: No reporting drama. Na di people wey understand di problem dey make decision.
car.e4d: Full freedom for technical decision, from architecture reach di last millisecond.
car.e5d: Work from our Paris office, hybrid, or fully remote inside Europe.
car.e6d: Robots, drones, XR headsets, surgical imaging — systems wey latency fit cause danger.
car.perksT: Di main tins, done well well.
car.p3: We go pay 50% of your public transport pass
car.p4: For office, hybrid or full remote for Europe
car.p6: Latest hardware: XR, robotics, GPU dem
car.perksNote: Di benefits dey follow French law and how dem dey do am; di details depend on di contract and where you dey.

One transport wey dey carry plenty stream and plenty actuator for QUIC, with latency wey low well-well. Na engineers from di VLC and FFmpeg community build am.
